entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""My very presence at this debate is..."

entries.menuText: "My very presence at this debate is proof of the lengths this man will go to cling to power. Sordland doesn't need another leader like that."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I am just as committed to Sordland..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am just as committed to Sordland's security as I was as the Minister of Interior. And I will devote my presidency to strengthening that security."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Well, it strikes me that none of m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, it strikes me that none of my opponents' grand plans are possible as long as our country is still vulnerable to threats from within and without its borders."

entries.title: Narrator: "Remus raised his fist."
entries.dialogueText: Remus raised his fist.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What are you insinuating? Ricter's..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are you insinuating? Ricter's death had nothing to do with me."

entries.dialogueText: "Ricter was an enemy of the state. He had to be dealt with."
entries.menuText: "Ricter was an enemy of the state. He had to be dealt with."

entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""If you truly believed that, you wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you truly believed that, you would have had the populace vaccinated. As in every other developed country."

entries.menuText: Don't interrupt.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We were lucky enough to stop the r..."

entries.menuText: "We were lucky enough to stop the recent polio outbreak, but we must be prepared in the event of further epidemics."

entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""The outbreak would have ended on i..."

entries.dialogueText: "Okay. Let's move on."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""This country is under attack from..."
entries.dialogueText: "This country is under attack from undesirable elements who would see it torn apart from within. They deserve nothing but expulsion from our services."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""One *could* say that, but--""
entries.dialogueText: "One *could* say that, but--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His face calm, he turned directly t..."
entries.dialogueText: His face calm, he turned directly to the camera.

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""And of course, the number-one mech..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, the number-one mechanism of oppression is capitalism."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Governing together, our parties wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Governing together, our parties will use the new reforms as a launchpad for new laws that ensure representation for every single Sordish citizen."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""You've already pledged to make the..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've already pledged to make the military a focus of your second term. Would you care to elaborate on that?"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I will work hard to pass the const..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will work hard to pass the constitutional reforms that he could not."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun nodded appreciatively and t..."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun nodded appreciatively and turned to the camera.

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""The moment I take office, I will u..."
entries.dialogueText: "The moment I take office, I will undo his constitutional changes and give power back to the people."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""My constitutional reforms will suc..."
entries.dialogueText: "My constitutional reforms will succeed where his failed and give power back to the people."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Polio is continuing to ravage our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Polio is continuing to ravage our country. Ending the epidemic is of the utmost importance."
entries.menuText: "Polio is continuing to ravage our country. Ending the epidemic is of the utmost importance."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Recent events have shown how impor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Recent events have shown how important it is for the government to keep a handle on unrest."
entries.menuText: "Recent events have shown how important it is for the government to keep a handle on unrest."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A strong military is the backbone..."
entries.dialogueText: "A strong military is the backbone of Sordland. It's as simple as that."
entries.menuText: "A strong military is the backbone of Sordland. It's as simple as that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun glared at me and turned to..."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun glared at me and turned to the camera.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Without an educated populace, Sord..."
entries.dialogueText: "Without an educated populace, Sordland is doomed to be stuck in the past. It's as simple as that."
entries.menuText: "Without an educated populace, Sordland is doomed to be stuck in the past. It's as simple as that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Kesaro cleared his throat."
entries.dialogueText: Kesaro cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Sordland is not free as long as it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland is not free as long as its women and minorities are still discriminated against. Only once we dismantle the mechanisms of oppression can we begin to move this country forward."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Devoting more resources towards ed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Devoting more resources towards education already paid enormous dividends during my first term. Why stop now?"
entries.menuText: "Devoting more resources towards education already paid enormous dividends during my first term. Why stop now?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Budget constraints during my first..."
entries.dialogueText: "Budget constraints during my first term meant Sordland's education system went underfunded. I regret that now."
entries.menuText: "Budget constraints during my first term meant Sordland's education system went underfunded. I regret that now."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""As president, I would crack down o..."
entries.dialogueText: "As president, I would crack down on the enemies of the state who are threatening to tear this country apart."

entries.dialogueText: "Enough! This is a debate, not a platform for your racist hate-mongering."
